name: portfolio-frontend
description: TypeScript sources for the public portfolio and the CMS dashboard

scripts.build:css: tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/styles/public.css -o ../static/dist/public.css --minify && tailwindcss -c tailwind.config.js -i src/styles/cms.css -o ../static/dist/cms.css --minify
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:js && npm run build:css
